description: Information technology has fundamentally transformed how businesses are innovating with new service and product offerings in an accelerated digital economy. In this new era of digital transformation, data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) are increasingly being harnessed to develop an in-depth understanding of customers thus enabling more effective engagement. Beyond customer engagement, businesses are also leveraging data and AI to automate business processes and digitise risk management and IT governance to improve resiliency. This course teaches students on how to design data/AI-driven business innovations in digital transformation of businesses.
